articles.title: Phillies-Rays: John Kruk out, Cole Hamels in on NBC Sports Philadelphia for wild-card fight
articles.description: NBC Sports Philadelphia will have a bit of a broadcast shuffle as the Phillies look to clinch a wild-card spot.

articles.title: Phillies’ bats continue to slumber as playoff chances take a hit with 2-0 loss to Rays
articles.description: With a win on Friday night, the Diamondbacks can move within one game of the Phillies, who could only muster four hits against the Rays, wasting a 10-strikeout outing by Cristopher Sánchez.

articles.title: Phillies’ quest to clinch a playoff spot stalls again with 5-1 loss to the Brewers
articles.description: The Phillies’ magic number remains two with a weekend series against the AL-leading Rays left to lock up a spot in the postseason.

articles.title: Phillies’ Luis Arraez leaves game vs. Brewers with a sprained left ankle
articles.description: Arraez tried to dodge a tag at first base and he appeared to twist his ankle and fell to the ground in pain. As the Phillies ’ push for a playoff berth continues, their offense was dealt a blow when ...

articles.title: Bill Giles, former Phillies owner who helped create Phillie Phanatic, died at 92
articles.description: Once described as “Philadelphia’s resident combination of P.T. Barnum and Walt Disney,” Mr. Giles got creative trying to attract fans. The biggest draw was the mascot he green lit in 1978.

articles.title: The Phillies camera operator who brings you the best slo-mo shots from the ballgame just released a stellar jazz album
articles.description: Greg Farnese croons in his own singular style and operates a camera at Citizens Bank Park. His debut album 'Oh No, I'm In Love Again,' is produced by Philly jazz pianist Orrin Evans.

articles.title: Alec Bohm represents changes that might be coming to the Phillies. Who else could be on the way out?
articles.description: Barring a deep run through October, several longstanding players — as well as interim manager Don Mattingly — face a cloudy future with the Phillies.

articles.title: Phillies’ chances of clinching a wild card put on hold with 4-1 loss to the Brewers
articles.description: The Phillies finished 0-for-12 with runners in scoring position and Aaron Nola allowed four runs across six innings.
